title: Intent outcome (intent-outcome/1)
description: What options-trading-agent did with a trade intent, posted back to `POST /api/trade_intents/:intent_id/outcome` (operator token). Every intent gets exactly one outcome, so Rails can show WHY a signal did or did not trade. Codes reuse the agent's existing drop codes plus the intake-specific ones.

code.description: Machine-readable reason. Examples: ENTRY_BLOCKED, STALE_AT_SUBMIT, NO_EXPIRY, RISK_BUDGET_TOO_SMALL, SLOT_BUSY, CIRCUIT_BREAKER, INTENT_EXPIRED, SCHEMA_INVALID.

detail.description: Human-readable detail, e.g. 'one lot risks 3120 against a budget of 2400'.

correlation_id.description: The agent's entry correlation id (e.g. E-20261118-0931-0007). Carried into entry_submitted events so one id traces signal -> order -> fill -> exit.
